rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to say that something is done in an artistic manner.

example.english: They treated the light and shadow in this painting artistically, giving it great depth.
example.traditional: 佢用藝術手法將呢幅畫嘅光影處理得好有層次。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 ngai6 seot6 sau2 faat3 zoeng1 ni1 fuk1 waa6 ge3 gwong1 jing2 cyu2 lei5 dak1 hou2 jau5 cang4 ci3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that the result or appearance feels artistic, rather than the technique used to create it.

example.english: They decorated the living room artistically, and the whole place immediately looked more upscale.
example.traditional: 佢將個客廳布置到有藝術感咁，成間屋即刻高級晒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoeng1 go3 haak3 teng1 bou3 zi3 dou3 jau5 ngai6 seot6 gam2 gam3 seng4 gaan1 uk1 zik1 hak1 gou1 kap1 saai3
